nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil moisture retention_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How does biochar affect the water-holding capacity of soil?
nodes.answer: Biochar increases the water-holding capacity of soil.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil moisture retention_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How does increasing water content affect oxygen availability in the soil?
nodes.answer: As water content increases, the diffusive oxygen supply decreases and the anaerobic soil volume may spread into larger areas with lower oxygen consumption rates.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Soil health management|Soil moisture retention_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What happens to radon release after heavy rains?
nodes.answer: After heavy rains, the soil can release radon more readily during periods of drying.
